benefits.text: Let Hince awaken your natural beauty with classic lipstick shades. True, rich color payoff and a soft, smooth texture bring out your hidden aura. The formula is thin and light yet melds into a matte layer on the lips for a beautiful blurry matte finish.

howToUse.text: Apply directly to lips, and you can layer multiple coats to reach the intensity you want.

safety.text:
For external use on the lip area only; do not use on damaged lips,
Stop use if any unusual signs appear and keep out of reach of children.

texture.text: Soft, smooth matte lipstick, thin and light.

positioning.text: Matte lipstick in classic beige pink, creating a soft, elegant lip color that is easy to wear every day.

sellingPoints.text: Thin, light formula; true, rich color payoff; soft, smooth blurry matte finish.

finish.text: Blurry matte / soft beige pink / natural.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Non-drying” should be understood as the feel of the lipstick texture, not as care or treatment for dry lips. For flaky lips, apply lip care first.

positioning.text: Matte lipstick in earthy orange beige, creating a warm, soft and stylish lip color for everyday makeup.

sellingPoints.text: Thin, light formula; earthy orange beige shade that easily sets a mood; soft, smooth blurry matte finish.

finish.text: Blurry matte / earthy orange beige / warm and soft.

claimDisclaimers.text: Beige/earthy orange shades may appear different depending on natural lip color. Do not claim it absolutely suits every lip color.

positioning.text: Matte lipstick in deep coral pink, creating a lightly fresh yet elegant lip color that is not too bright.

sellingPoints.text: Thin, light formula; easy-to-wear deep coral pink; blurry matte finish.

finish.text: Blurry matte / deep coral pink / soft.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not say it actually brightens skin. This is a lip color effect within the overall makeup look.

sellingPoints.text: Thin, light formula; brick-tinged purple with depth; soft, smooth blurry matte finish.

finish.text: Blurry matte / brick purple / with depth.

claimDisclaimers.text: The brick-tinged purple shade may appear different depending on natural lip color. Do not claim it suits every undertone.

positioning.text: Matte lipstick in chocolate brown, creating a deep, warm, bold lip color with clear depth.

finish.text: Blurry matte / chocolate brown / deep and warm.

positioning.text: Matte lipstick in deep red, creating a defined, elegant lip color with presence.

claimDisclaimers.text: “Long-wearing” should not be interpreted as absolutely budge-proof or as color that lasts through eating and drinking.

sellingPoints.text: Thin, light formula; easy-to-wear deep beige pink; blurry matte finish that feels soft on the lips.

finish.text: Blurry matte / deep beige pink / natural.
